meta.name: Windows apps (Wine) demo
meta.author: you
meta.description: Run Windows applications on the desktop — Phase 6a, the 'wine' tier (docs/strata-design.md §14). Each app gets its OWN Wine prefix so one app's overrides can't break another. Every app is checked against the compatibility oracle first: apps Wine structurally can't run (kernel anti-cheat, CAD, dongles, Store packages) are reported with the tier that could run them instead of being half-installed. Check any app yourself with `manifest windows-check <name|installer.exe>`. The VM tiers (vm-rdp / vm-vfio, for SolidWorks and friends) are designed but not built yet.
